product_summary: HDFC Bank's Plot Loans facilitate the acquisition of land for constructing your dream home. These loans support purchase of plots through direct allotment or resale.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Stamp duty, CERSAI charges, legal verification charges, administrative charges up to Rs.5000 applicable. Senior citizens get 10% discount on service charges.

collateral_accepted: First mortgage on the property being financed
documents_required: Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/NREGA Job Card/NPR Letter/Aadhaar
Last 6 months bank statements showing salary credits
Income returns with computation for 2 AYs with CA attestation (self-employed)
Last 2 years balance sheet and P&L with CA attestation (self-employed)
Title deeds and property chain documents (resale)
Employment contract/appointment letter if <1 year tenure
Last 6 months bank statements showing loan repayments
List of ongoing loans with details
key_features: End-to-end digital process with approval in 4 steps
Loan balance transfer facility from other institutions
Loans for construction on freehold/leasehold plots
Up to 80% LTV for loans up to Rs.75 lakhs
fees_table_raw: Processing Fee: 0.50%-1.50% of loan amount or Rs.4000-5000 flat (whichever higher) plus taxes. Conversion Fee: Up to 0.50% or Rs.3000 (whichever lower) for floating rate switch. Premature Closure: 2% + taxes on fixed rate loans. Administrative Charges: Up to Rs.5000 + taxes. Stamp Duty, CERSAI, Legal Verification: At actuals. Payment Return: Rs.450. Repayment Mode Change: Rs.500. Property Document Custody: Rs.1000/month after 2 months from closure.
